dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Oh... How did I lose...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: I won! Hehehe!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Oh no... I lost... The pigeons have flown away too...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Yes! I won... Eh? What's with the pigeons?

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: ...What're you doing! You're scaring the pigeons away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's not much I can do about it now...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Not much you can do? Hmph. Yeah, right!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Mommy says that as long as you love the world, no animals will be scared of you!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Otherwise, why do you think the pigeons aren't scared of me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They'll be back.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: They do come back usually... But what happens if one day they leave and never come back again?

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Just like Daddy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: Wah... I'm telling Mommy on you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: I'm thinking that Stormterror must be... a transformed flock of pigeons.

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: People like you always scare them, so they turned into a dragon to get their revenge!

dialogues.speaker: Timmie
dialogues.text: But they definitely wouldn't hurt someone who's always been nice to them, like me... would they?
